The deferred queue read behavior ("unless this step left another pickup's session unarchived: then do not read the queue in this turn", "Report `claude-issue-pickup: restarted; first queue read at the next hourly wake`", and "A restart that leaves the older pickup's session unarchived reads nothing until its own first hourly wake") is absent from .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md.
